name.ja: HG 1/144 ドラグナー2 リフター2装備タイプ

ja: 『機甲戦記ドラグナー』よりドラグナー２ リフター２装備タイプが新規造形でＨＧシリーズに登場！ドラグナー２の機体形状、武装類を最新のフォーマットで再現。背面に装備可能なリフター２は可動ギミックを搭載し、「駐機状態」など劇中イメージを再現可能。豊富な武装類は新規造形を交えて徹底再現。

●　ドラグナー２が新規造形で立体化！　　現代の技術で再現されるメタルアーマー　　ＨＧで初商品化となるドラグナー２を設定画や作中イメージを踏襲しつつ細部まで徹底的にこだわり理想を追求して立体化。　　広い可動域や各ギミックを搭載し、劇中のようなアクションが可能。　　特徴的なデザインをパーツ分割で再現。　　脚部のカラーリングはパーツ分割により成形色で再現。　    バックパックの特徴的なデザインはプラスチックシールで再現。　　内部フレームを再現！　　アーマーを装着することでドラグナー２を組み立て可能。　　２８０ｍｍレールキャノンと７５ｍｍ２連装自動砲はフレキシブルに可動。
●　最新のＨＧの基準で「リフター２」装備を再現　　ドラグナー２専用のフライトユニットを装備した状態。　　「リフター２」を立体化。主翼は可動し、駐機状態を再現可能。
●　多彩な武装が付属！　　迫兵戦用アサルトナイフは脹脛部に収納され着脱が可能。
●　フルカラーパッケージでお届け
付属武装：リフター２/８８ｍｍ ハンドレールガンＬＰＳ７型/２８０ｍｍレールキャノン×２／７５ｍｍ２連装自動砲×２／２連２５ｍｍ機関砲×２／迫兵戦用アサルトナイフ×２

The Dragoner 2 lifter 2 equipment type from “Dragoner” is now available in the HG series with a new model! Dragonar 2's aircraft shape and weapons are reproduced in the latest format. Lifter 2, which can be installed on the back, is equipped with a movable gimmick and can reproduce images from the play such as "parked aircraft". The rich variety of weapons has been thoroughly reproduced with new modeling.

● Dragonar 2 is now three-dimensional with new modeling! Metal Armor reproduced with modern technology Dragonar 2, which will be commercialized for the first time in HG, has been made into a three-dimensional model, following the setting image and the image in the work, paying close attention to detail and pursuing the ideal. Equipped with a wide range of motion and various gimmicks, it is possible to perform actions like those in the movie. The characteristic design is reproduced by dividing it into parts. The coloring of the legs is reproduced by molding color by dividing the parts. The distinctive design of the backpack is reproduced with plastic Seal. Reproduce the internal frame! Dragonar 2 can be assembled by equipping the armor. The 280mm rail cannon and 75mm twin automatic cannon are flexibly movable.

●Reproduces the "Lifter 2 " equipment using the latest HG standards Equipped with a flight unit exclusively for Dragoner 2. " Lifter 2" is made into three-dimensional. The main wings are movable and the parked state can be reproduced.
● Comes with a variety of weapons! The assault knife for mortar combat is stored in the calf and can be attached and detached.
Attached weapons: Lifter 2/88mm hand rail gun LPS7 type/280mm rail cannon x 2/75mm twin automatic cannon x 2/double 25mm machine gun x 2/Assault knife for mortar combat x 2
1/144 Scale Assembly type plastic model Target age: 15 years old and above Upper product material: PS, PE, PET, no adhesive is used for the assembly.
